text: 下面进入小作文 04 · 邀请信：邀请外籍教授担任英语演讲比赛评委，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 代表组织邀请】用敬语表达“代表学生会，我很荣幸诚挚邀请您担任评委”：
On behalf of the Student Union, I am honored to extend a cordial invitation for you to serve as a judge in our upcoming English Speech Contest.
手术刀点拨：extend a cordial invitation 是邀请信核心高频短语，比 invite you warmly 更显正式尊重。
【二段 · 时间地点主题】不要写 We will hold the event。请用物称主语 + with 介词短语交代活动时间地点与主题：
The event is scheduled to take place in the University Hall from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. next Friday, with the theme of Cross-Cultural Communication.
手术刀点拨：is scheduled to take place + with the theme of 一步交代 3 要素，零语法隐患。
【二段升华 · 赞美教授作用】用倒装表达“您的见解不仅激励选手，还能提升比赛水准”：
Knowing your keen interest in language teaching, we believe not only can your insights inspire all contestants, but they will also elevate the quality of the competition.
手术刀点拨：对上级教授务必突出对方专业评价的价值（inspire / elevate the quality），并注意尾段礼貌请求。
